correctness.rationale: PASS: For u with valuation s<m, summing products bc=u over each allowed b-valuation i<=s gives (s+1)(q-1)q^{m-1}; for u=0, summing all b-shell kernels plus b=0 gives q^{m-1}[m(q-1)+q]. Writing A=(a,b;c,t-a) and x=2a-t, the determinant constraint becomes 4bc=Delta-x^2, so N=sum_x H(nu(Delta-x^2)). For valuation v odd, no cancellation is possible with a square; for even v=2h, cancellation occurs only in x-shell h. Simple-root lifting (2 invertible) gives exactly two roots at each quotient if the unit residue is square, with q^h lifts at full length. Counting valuation classes proves the displayed closed four-case formulas. Independently re-enumerated every trace-det fiber of matrices over Z/3, Z/9 and Z/25, checking the discriminant sum. General finite chain rings follow by these ring-theoretic counts, not finite experimentation.
